facts.fact: 婚后僵局：他向 Inés 诉苦——Perla 硬得像铁、他的钱比来时还少、她寸步不让。
facts.anchor: “As if I haven’t been trying. She’s as hard as iron. I now have less money than I had when I arrived. She won’t budge.”

facts.fact: 计划升级：最坏情况他可以撬姨妈书桌（自认不擅长、费时），里面有现金、旅行支票、有用文件。
facts.anchor: But if worse comes to worst, I could try.

facts.fact: 作案窗口：每月第一个星期日全镇妇女去教堂念玫瑰经；Inés 装病留家做内应。
facts.anchor: “The first Sunday of the month, that’s the day when all the women in town pray the rosary.

facts.fact: 送茶梳床时探病：Nepomuceno 胃痛自称「战伤」，她怼「你根本没当过兵」；叙述交代教授是她事实上的父亲。
facts.anchor: She did. She’d had no proper father, as her aunt liked to remind her.

facts.fact: Estrella 宿命论：教授灵魂是歪的、生辰注定；Fito 因要涨薪差点被打，欠租两月自知将被赶。
facts.anchor: “He’s the way he is. His soul is crooked. It’s because of the day of the month he was born.

facts.fact: 第一个星期日行动：Perla 去教堂念经，Ulises 撬书桌锁，几次失败后终于掀开桌面。
facts.anchor: His first couple attempts were futile, and he cursed loudly.

facts.fact: 重大发现一：祖父 Osorio 的遗嘱写明房子归 Perla、Perla 身后归外孙女 Inés；Perla 本人迷信不立遗嘱。
facts.anchor: “Right here,” he said, tapping his finger against the page.

facts.fact: 重大发现二：抽屉里一叠写着 Inés Inclán 收的信——生父 1942 年 3 月 3 日已下葬，姨妈隐匿整整一年，从未转达。
facts.anchor: Inés opened a drawer. It was a stack of letters.

facts.fact: 现金仅两千比索、无旅行支票；她当场濒临昏厥。
facts.anchor: “That’s two thousand pesos in cash and not even a measly traveler’s check.

facts.fact: 她消化真相：父亲在乎过一点点，被姨妈截流；「我可以杀了她！」脱口而出，他答「那你能得房子，但会进监狱」。
facts.anchor: He’d cared a little, it seemed. Her aunt had snatched that trickle of feeling from her.

facts.fact: 谋杀逻辑成形：Perla 无遗嘱→若死，丈夫与侄女对半分遗产——凶案照片般的画面同时跳进两人脑中。
facts.anchor: They stared at each other. The image of Perla’s death was sharp and vivid, leaping into her mind as clearly as a crime scene photograph, and, she was sure, into his at the same moment. At last, he shook his head.

facts.fact: 夜里他来安慰噩梦惊醒的她；「我杀她白杀不如为利润杀」「你得伪装成意外」「你没说不」——他捧她脸颊，她吓得半死。
facts.anchor: He cupped her cheek, and her heart leaped in her chest.
